MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The external hard drive fits my computer projects because I could use it to back up files and store Raspberry Pi images.",
    "Recommending storage makes sense given my memory-card purchases, although the external drive serves a different, useful purpose rather than duplicating them."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Smart speakers and streaming devices do not help with my current focus on computer maintenance, wired networking, and organizing my setup.",
    "More HDMI cables are related to something I bought, but I have no current need for a replacement, extra length, or a five-pack.",
    "The full-size SD card does not directly fit my microSD needs, and the desktop memory is only useful if my computer supports those specific modules.",
    "Owning a Kindle does not mean I currently want another portable screen."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in electronics seems to have been treated as interest in smart-home and streaming products generally.",
    "Past cable and memory-card purchases seem to have been taken as reasons to offer more of the same without considering fit or whether the need is already met."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent Ethernet adapter, network cables, headphone mount, and computer duster point toward improving and maintaining an existing workspace.",
    "Compatibility matters: microSD and full-size SD are not interchangeable for my purposes, and a memory upgrade requires knowing what my computer supports.",
    "Useful additions solve a remaining problem, such as file backup, rather than repeat an accessory I already have."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in electronics but missed my current emphasis on practical, compatible additions to my computer setup."
}
